{{Quote|And who's the guy on the travois?|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 7">[[Star Wars (1977) 7|''Star Wars'' (1977) 7]]</ref>}}
The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Pera]] in [[Tun Aduban]] used a [[bobtail bantha]] to pull a '''travois''' bearing the corpse of a [[borg]] to [[Spacer's Hill]].
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used a travois to carry [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] inside the forest on [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]].
